tool_input.command: echo "=== initial_export.csv ===" ; head -5 data/initial_export.csv ; echo ; echo "=== rows ===" ; wc -l data/initial_export.csv ; echo ; echo "=== new_export.csv ===" ; head -5 data/reload/new_export.csv ; echo ; echo "=== rows ===" ; wc -l data/reload/new_export.csv
hops fg create --help 2>&1 ; echo "=====INSERT=====" ; hops fg insert --help 2>&1

hops fg create customers0f2f34 --version 1 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --features "row_id:string:unique record key,name:string,balance_eur:double:balance in EUR,updated_at:bigint:epoch ms event time" --description "Customers initial schema" 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg insert customers0f2f34 --version 1 --file data/initial_export.csv 2>&1 | tail -25

hops fg create customers0f2f34 --version 2 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --online --features "row_id:string:unique record key,full_name:string:replaces name,balance:double:balance in varying currency,currency:string:ISO code,updated_at:bigint:epoch ms event time" --description "Customers new breaking schema, online enabled" 2>&1 | tail -15
hops fg insert customers0f2f34 --version 2 --file data/reload/new_export.csv 2>&1 | tail -25

hops fg info customers0f2f34 --version 2 2>&1 | grep -vE "INFO:|UserWarning|To ensure|pip install|^$" ; echo "=====FEATURES=====" ; hops fg features customers0f2f34 --version 2 2>&1 | grep -vE "INFO:|UserWarning|To ensure|pip install|^$"

hops fg preview customers0f2f34 --version 2 --n 5 2>&1 | grep -vE "INFO:|UserWarning|To ensure|pip install|^$" ; echo "=====STATS=====" ; hops fg stats customers0f2f34 --version 2 2>&1 | grep -vE "INFO:|UserWarning|To ensure|pip install|^$" | head -25
